description: This file defines a command handler class for disassociating groups from a center within the Fineract system. It implements the logic to process commands related to disassociating groups from a center entity.

classes.name: DisassociateGroupsFromCenterCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles commands for disassociating groups from a center. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses GroupingTypesWritePlatformService to perform the disassociation.

methods.name: DisassociateGroupsFromCenterCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with the required write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to disassociate groups from a center by invoking the write platform service method.
